decided: The sensor watching a change's planned files fires on source files the plan did not list only when one of them changed by more than 40 lines, or when such files make up more than 20% of the change's source lines; tests, docs and orbit's own folder are exempt by default. All of these are settings, fixed when building begins.
alternatives: fire on any unlisted source file outside the exempt paths, as first chosen
why: Across the 14 latest finished changes, the first choice would have fired on 8, almost all for edits of four lines or fewer to shared files; with these limits it fires on one, a 138-line module the plan never named.

defines.definition: A check orbit runs over the code, the change and its history that reports whether a run has gone off course.
